translations.idiomatic: He also argued: "Cutting city-wall budgets is meant to save money.

sentences.zh: 用省而工惡，再修且倍之。」

translations.literal: If savings are made but the work is shoddy, repair will cost twice as much."
translations.idiomatic: If costs are cut but the work is poor, rebuilding will cost twice as much."

sentences.zh: 上皆韙其言。

translations.literal: The emperor approved all his statements.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor endorsed everything he said.

sentences.zh: 常州俗好佛，家設靜堂，自立名教。

translations.literal: Changzhou custom favored Buddhism; households set up Quiet Halls and established their own sects.
translations.idiomatic: Changzhou was fond of Buddhism; families set up "quiet halls" and formed their own sects.

sentences.zh: 江寧、松江、太倉漸染其習。

translations.literal: Jiangning, Songjiang, and Taicang gradually took up the practice.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangning, Songjiang, and Taicang gradually adopted the same practice.

sentences.zh: 大受疏請飭有司防禁，移佛入廟；

translations.literal: Dashou memorialized requesting officials be ordered to guard against and prohibit it, moving Buddha images into temples;
translations.idiomatic: Dashou memorialized asking officials to suppress the practice, move Buddha images into proper temples,

sentences.zh: 堂內人田屋產，量為處置。

translations.literal: and the land, houses, and property of hall members to be disposed of as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: and dispose of the halls' land, houses, and property as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「此等事須實力，不可欲速。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "Matters like these require solid effort; one must not seek haste.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied: "Matters like this require real effort; you must not try to finish too quickly.

sentences.zh: 不然，則所謂好事不如無也。」

translations.literal: Otherwise, as the saying goes, a misguided good deed is worse than none at all."
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise, as the saying goes, a botched good deed is worse than doing nothing at all."

sentences.zh: 十一年，加太子少保，調福建。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, he was given the additional title Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent and transferred to Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was made Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent and transferred to Fujian.

sentences.zh: 十二年，疏言：「近海商民，例許往暹羅造船販米。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, he memorialized: "Coastal merchants are by regulation permitted to go to Siam to build ships and trade in rice.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he memorialized: "Coastal merchants are by regulation allowed to go to Siam to build ships and trade in rice.

sentences.zh: 內渡時若有船無米，應倍稅示罰。」

translations.literal: When returning inland, if there is a ship but no rice, double taxation should be imposed as punishment."
translations.idiomatic: When they return inland, if they bring a ship but no rice, they should be taxed at double the usual rate as a penalty."

sentences.zh: 部議從之。

translations.literal: The ministry approved.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry agreed.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「巡台御史巡南北二路，台灣、鳳山、諸羅、彰化四縣具廚傳犒賞，往往濫準詞訟。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Touring censors of Taiwan circuit patrol the north and south routes; the four counties of Taiwan, Fengshan, Zhuluo, and Changhua provide lodgings and rewards, often indiscriminately accepting lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "When touring censors of Taiwan patrol the north and south routes, the four counties of Taiwan, Fengshan, Zhuluo, and Changhua provide lodging and rewards, and lawsuits are often accepted indiscriminately.

sentences.zh: 又於額設胥役外，俾奸民注籍，恃符生事。」

translations.literal: Beyond the quota of clerks and runners, wicked people are registered and rely on their credentials to cause trouble."
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the authorized clerks and runners, scoundrels are registered on the rolls and use their credentials to stir up trouble."

sentences.zh: 上命自乾隆五年起，巡台御史均下部嚴議。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered that from the fifth year of Qianlong onward, touring censors of Taiwan be all referred to the ministry for strict deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered that from the fifth year of Qianlong onward, every touring censor of Taiwan be referred to the ministry for strict review.

sentences.zh: 又疏言：「台灣番民生業艱難，向漢民重息稱貸。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "Taiwan aborigines find livelihood difficult and borrow from Han Chinese at usurious rates.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized: "Taiwan aborigines struggle to make a living and borrow from Han Chinese at crushing interest.

sentences.zh: 子女田產，每被盤折。

translations.literal: Their children, wives, and land are often seized through oppression.
translations.idiomatic: Their children, wives, and land are often seized through extortion.

sentences.zh: 請撥台穀二萬石分貯諸羅、彰化、淡水諸縣，視鳳山例接濟。

translations.literal: I request that twenty thousand shi of Taiwan grain be allocated and stored separately in Zhuluo, Changhua, and Danshui counties, following the Fengshan precedent for relief lending.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that twenty thousand shi of Taiwan grain be allocated and stored in Zhuluo, Changhua, and Danshui, following the Fengshan precedent for relief lending.

sentences.zh: 其不原借者聽。」

translations.literal: Those unwilling to borrow need not."
translations.idiomatic: Those who do not wish to borrow need not do so."

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 台灣民、番雜處，土音非譯不通。

translations.literal: In Taiwan Han and aborigines live mingled; local dialects cannot be understood without translation.
translations.idiomatic: Han and aborigines lived mingled in Taiwan, and local speech could not be understood without an interpreter.

sentences.zh: 有奸民殺人賄通事，移坐番罪​​，疑之，再鞫，竟得白。

translations.literal: A wicked person killed someone and bribed the interpreter to shift blame onto an aborigine; Dashou was suspicious, re-examined the case, and the truth was finally revealed.
translations.idiomatic: When a scoundrel killed a man and bribed the interpreter to shift the crime onto an aborigine, Dashou was suspicious, re-examined the case, and finally cleared the innocent party.

sentences.zh: 或言海上有島十四，為田萬餘畝，可開墾，前政以入告。

translations.literal: Some said there were fourteen islands at sea with more than ten thousand mu of fields that could be opened for cultivation; the previous administration had reported this for approval.
translations.idiomatic: Some claimed there were fourteen offshore islands with more than ten thousand mu of land that could be opened for cultivation; the previous administration had reported the proposal for approval.

sentences.zh: 大受以島地久在禁令，一旦開禁，聚人既多，生姦尤易。

translations.literal: Dashou argued that the islands had long been under prohibition; once opened, with many people gathering, mischief would be especially easy.
translations.idiomatic: Dashou argued that the islands had long been under prohibition; once opened, a large influx of settlers would make wrongdoing especially easy.

sentences.zh: 設兵彈壓，為費彌甚，利不敵害，輒奏罷之。

translations.literal: Stationing troops to suppress trouble would cost far more; benefit would not outweigh harm; he memorialized to stop the plan.
translations.idiomatic: Garrisoning troops to keep order would cost far more; the gain would not justify the harm, and he memorialized to stop the plan.

sentences.zh: 召授兵部尚書。

translations.literal: He was summoned and appointed minister of the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned to court and appointed minister of war.

sentences.zh: 十三年，調吏部，協辦大學士、軍機處行走。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, he was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel, assisting grand secretary and serving in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel, assisting the grand secretary and serving in the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 十四年，金川平，晉太子太傅。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, when the Jinchuan campaign was pacified, he was promoted to Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, after the pacification of Jinchuan, he was promoted to Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 秋，署直隸總督。

translations.literal: In autumn, he served as acting governor-general of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he served as acting governor-general of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 十五年，授兩廣總督。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, he was appointed governor-general of the Two Guangs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was appointed governor-general of Guangdong and Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 陛辭請訓，上曰：「汝直軍機處兩年，萬幾之事，皆所目擊，即朕訓也。

translations.literal: At his audience of farewell he requested instruction; the emperor said: "You served directly in the Grand Council for two years; you witnessed all matters of state—that is Our instruction.
translations.idiomatic: At his farewell audience he asked for instruction. The emperor said: "You served in the Grand Council for two years and saw every matter of state firsthand—that is my instruction to you.

sentences.zh: 何贅辭？

translations.literal: Why redundant words?
translations.idiomatic: Why ask for more words?

sentences.zh: 惟中外一心足矣。」

translations.literal: Only that court and provinces be of one mind is enough."
translations.idiomatic: Only that court and provinces act as one is enough."

sentences.zh: 尋命協理粵海關。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was ordered to assist in managing the Guangdong maritime customs.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered to assist in managing the Guangdong maritime customs.

sentences.zh: 兩粵去京師遠，吏媮民哤，大受以猛治之，舉劾不法吏，政令大行。

translations.literal: The Two Guangs were far from the capital; officials were shiftless and the people unruly; Dashou governed sternly, impeaching lawless officials, and government orders were widely enforced.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong and Guangxi were far from the capital; officials were lax and the people unruly. Dashou governed sternly, impeaching corrupt officials, and his orders were widely enforced.

sentences.zh: 十六年，以病乞解任，溫詔慰留。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, ill, he asked to be relieved; a warm edict comforted him and kept him in office.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he asked to resign because of illness, but a warm edict comforted him and kept him in office.

sentences.zh: 未幾，卒，賜祭葬，諡文肅，祀賢良祠。

translations.literal: Before long he died; granted ceremonial burial, posthumous title Wensu, enshrined in the Hall of Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he died. He was granted ceremonial burial, given the posthumous title Wensu, and enshrined in the Hall of Worthies.

sentences.zh: 大受眉目皆上起，豐髯有威。

translations.literal: Dashou's eyebrows and eyes all turned upward; he had a full beard and an imposing presence.
translations.idiomatic: Dashou's brows and eyes all turned upward, and his full beard gave him an imposing air.

sentences.zh: 清節推海內。

translations.literal: His integrity was acclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: His integrity was renowned throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 以微時極貧，祿不逮親養，自奉如布衣時。

translations.literal: Having been extremely poor in humble days, his salary could not reach to support his parents; he maintained himself as in his commoner days.
translations.idiomatic: Because he had been desperately poor in his youth and his salary could not reach home to support his parents, he lived as simply as he had as a commoner.

sentences.zh: 子輝祖，自有傳。

translations.literal: His son Huizu has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: His son Huizu has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 張允隨，字覲臣，漢軍鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Zhang Yunsui, styled Jinchen, was a Han Chinese bannerman of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yunsui, styled Jinchen, was a Han bannerman of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 祖一魁，福建邵武知府，有政績，祀名宦。

translations.literal: His grandfather Yi Kui was prefect of Shaowu in Fujian, had administrative achievements, and was enshrined among famous officials.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Yi Kui had served as prefect of Shaowu in Fujian, won a reputation for good administration, and was enshrined among distinguished officials.

sentences.zh: 允隨入貲為光祿寺典簿，遷江南寧國同知，擢雲南楚雄知府。

translations.literal: Yunsui purchased office as registry clerk of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, was transferred to vice prefect of Ningguo in Jiangnan, and was promoted to prefect of Chuxiong in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Yunsui purchased office as a registry clerk in the Court of Imperial Entertainments, was transferred to vice prefect of Ningguo in Jiangnan, and was promoted to prefect of Chuxiong in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，調廣南。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, he was transferred to Guangnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Yongzheng reign he was transferred to Guangnan.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，總督鄂爾泰等請留司銅廠。

translations.literal: Upon mourning for his mother, Governor-General Ortai and others requested he remain to manage the copperworks.
translations.idiomatic: When he entered mourning for his mother, Governor-General Ortai and others asked that he be kept on to manage the copperworks.

sentences.zh: 二年，授曲靖知府，擢糧儲道。

translations.literal: In the second year, he was appointed prefect of Qujing and promoted to grain storage intendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was appointed prefect of Qujing and promoted to grain storage intendant.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰复薦可大任，上召入見。

translations.literal: Ortai again recommended him as fit for great responsibility; the emperor summoned him for an audience.
translations.idiomatic: Ortai again recommended him for greater responsibility, and the emperor summoned him for an audience.

sentences.zh: 五年，擢按察使。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, he was promoted to surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was promoted to surveillance commissioner.

sentences.zh: 未幾，遷布政使。

translations.literal: Before long, he was transferred to provincial administration commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was made provincial administration commissioner.

sentences.zh: 雲南產銅供鑄錢，寶源、寶泉二局需銅急，責委員領帑採洋銅，洋銅不時至。

translations.literal: Yunnan produced copper for coinage; the Baoyuan and Baoquan mints urgently needed copper; commissioners were charged to draw funds and procure foreign copper, but foreign copper did not arrive regularly.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan produced copper for coinage, and the Baoyuan and Baoquan mints urgently needed it. Commissioners were ordered to draw funds and procure imported copper, but the shipments did not arrive on schedule.

sentences.zh: 允隨綜銅廠事，察知舊廠產尚富，增其值。

translations.literal: Yunsui took overall charge of copperworks affairs, found that old mines still had rich output, and raised their prices.
translations.idiomatic: Yunsui took overall charge of the copperworks, found that the old mines still had rich output, and raised the purchase price.

sentences.zh: 民樂於開採，舊廠復盛。

translations.literal: The people were glad to mine; the old works flourished again.
translations.idiomatic: The people were eager to mine, and the old works flourished again.

sentences.zh: 又開大龍、湯丹諸新廠，歲得銅八九百萬斤供用。

translations.literal: He also opened new mines at Dalong, Tangdan, and elsewhere, yielding eight or nine million jin of copper annually for use.
translations.idiomatic: He also opened new mines at Dalong, Tangdan, and elsewhere, yielding eight or nine million jin of copper each year.

sentences.zh: 乃停採洋銅，國帑省，官累亦除。

translations.literal: He then stopped procuring foreign copper, saving the state treasury and lifting the burden on officials.
translations.idiomatic: He then stopped procuring imported copper, saving the treasury and lifting the burden on officials.

sentences.zh: 八年，調貴州。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he was transferred to Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was transferred to Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 未幾，授雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: Before long, he was appointed governor of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was appointed governor of Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 允隨官雲南久，熟知郡國利病，山川險要，苗、夷情狀。

translations.literal: Yunsui had served in Yunnan for a long time and knew well the strengths and weaknesses of each commandery, the strategic terrain, and the conditions of the Miao and Yi peoples.
translations.idiomatic: Yunsui had served in Yunnan for many years and knew intimately each commandery's strengths and weaknesses, the strategic terrain, and the ways of the Miao and Yi peoples.

sentences.zh: 十一年，思茅土酋刁興國糾徼外苦蔥蠻等為亂，蔓延數州縣。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Simao native chieftain Diao Xingguo rallied Kuchong tribesmen from beyond the frontier and others in rebellion; it spread across several prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, Diao Xingguo, the native chieftain of Simao, rallied the Kuchong tribesmen beyond the frontier and others in rebellion, and the unrest spread across several prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 允隨與總督高其倬遣兵討之，思茅圍解。

translations.literal: Yunsui together with Governor-General Gao Qizhuo dispatched troops to suppress them; the siege of Simao was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Yunsui and Governor-General Gao Qizhuo dispatched troops to suppress the rebels, and the siege of Simao was lifted.

sentences.zh: 亂苗遁攸樂，知縣章綸以事詣會城，至蟃蜯村，遇寇死。

translations.literal: The rebel Miao fled to Youle; Magistrate Zhang Lun, traveling to the provincial capital on official business, reached Manhuang Village and was killed by bandits.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel Miao fled to Youle. Magistrate Zhang Lun was traveling to the provincial capital on official business when he reached Manhuang Village and was killed by bandits.

sentences.zh: 允隨趣兵進，擒興國。

translations.literal: Yunsui hurried troops forward and captured Xingguo.
translations.idiomatic: Yunsui pressed forward with troops and captured Xingguo.

sentences.zh: 餘眾走臨安，复擊破之。

translations.literal: The remnant forces fled to Lin'an; he again attacked and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: The remnant forces fled to Lin'an, and he attacked and defeated them again.

sentences.zh: 允隨疏以鎮沅、思樂府縣皆新改土為流，請立學，設教職，定學額。

translations.literal: Yunsui memorialized that Zhenyuan and Sile prefectures and counties had all newly been converted from native chieftain rule to direct administration, and requested establishing schools, appointing instructors, and fixing enrollment quotas.
translations.idiomatic: Yunsui memorialized that Zhenyuan and Sile, having all recently been converted from native chieftain rule to direct administration, needed schools established, instructors appointed, and enrollment quotas fixed.

sentences.zh: 又疏以雲南各府州或兵少米多，請以額徵秋米石折銀一兩；

translations.literal: He also memorialized that in various prefectures and departments of Yunnan, some had few troops but much rice, and requested that for each shi of autumn rice levied by quota, one tael of silver be accepted in lieu;
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized that in Yunnan's prefectures and departments, some posts had too few troops for their grain allotments, and proposed accepting one tael of silver in lieu of each shi of quota autumn rice;

sentences.zh: 或兵多米少，請以額徵條銀兩收米一石。

translations.literal: or where troops were many but rice scarce, that for each tael of quota silver levied, one shi of rice be accepted.
translations.idiomatic: while where troops were many but grain scarce, one shi of rice should be accepted for each tael of quota silver.

sentences.zh: 十二年，疏請於廣西府開爐鼓鑄。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, he memorialized requesting that smelting furnaces be opened at Guangxi Prefecture for coin casting.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he memorialized requesting that smelting furnaces be opened at Guangxi Prefecture to cast coin.

sentences.zh: 皆下部議行。

translations.literal: All were referred to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: All were referred to the ministries for deliberation and approval.

sentences.zh: 十三年，疏報蒙化墾田二十六頃有奇。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, he memorialized reporting twenty-six-plus qing of reclaimed land at Menghua.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he reported by memorial that twenty-six-odd qing of land had been reclaimed at Menghua.

sentences.zh: 三年，請停鑄錢運京。

translations.literal: In the third year, he requested stopping transport of minted coins to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he requested that minted coin no longer be transported to the capital.

sentences.zh: 是冬，入覲。

translations.literal: That winter, he went to court for an audience.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he traveled to court for an audience.

sentences.zh: 四年，正歲，上宴廷臣，賦柏梁體詩，允隨與焉。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, at New Year's, the emperor feasted court ministers and composed poems in the Bailiang style; Yunsui was among them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, at the New Year feast, the emperor entertained his ministers and composed poems in the Bailiang style; Yunsui was among those present.

sentences.zh: 五年，疏言：「雲南鹽不敷民食，安寧得洪源井，試煎，年獲二十一萬餘斤。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, he memorialized: "Yunnan's salt does not suffice for the people's needs. At Anning the Hongyuan well was found; trial boiling yielded over 210,000 jin annually.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he memorialized: "Yunnan's salt supply falls short of the people's needs. At Anning the Hongyuan well was discovered; trial boiling yielded more than 210,000 jin each year.

sentences.zh: 麗江得老姆井，試煎，年獲十八萬餘斤。

translations.literal: At Lijiang the Laomu well was found; trial boiling yielded over 180,000 jin annually.
translations.idiomatic: At Lijiang the Laomu well was discovered; trial boiling yielded more than 180,000 jin each year.

sentences.zh: 分地行銷，定為年額。」

translations.literal: Sales were divided by region and fixed as annual quotas."
translations.idiomatic: Salt was allotted by region for sale and fixed as an annual quota."

sentences.zh: 上獎為有益之事。

translations.literal: The emperor praised this as a beneficial undertaking.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised the proposal as a worthwhile measure.

sentences.zh: 署貴州總督。

translations.literal: He served as acting governor-general of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He served as acting governor-general of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 六年，廣東妖民黃順等遁匿貴州境，有司捕得奏聞。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Guangdong sorcery sect followers Huang Shun and others fled and hid in Guizhou territory; local officials captured them and reported to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Huang Shun and other sorcery sect followers from Guangdong fled into Guizhou and went into hiding; local officials captured them and reported the matter to the throne.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「汝不以五日京兆自居，盡心治事可嘉。」

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "You do not regard yourself as a five-day governor of the capital—your devoted handling of affairs is commendable."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed him: "You do not treat your post like a temporary appointment in the capital; your devoted service is commendable."

sentences.zh: 复署雲南總督。

translations.literal: He again served as acting governor-general of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: He again served as acting governor-general of Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 兵部議各省有增設兵額，量加裁減。

translations.literal: The Board of War deliberated that provinces with newly added troop quotas should have them proportionally reduced.
translations.idiomatic: The Board of War proposed that newly added troop quotas in the provinces be reduced in proportion.

sentences.zh: 允隨奏：「雲南昭通、普洱二鎮有增設兵額，地處邊要，未可裁減。

translations.literal: Yunsui memorialized: "The Zhaotong and Pu'er garrisons in Yunnan have newly added troop quotas; they are in strategically important border regions and cannot be reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Yunsui memorialized: "The Zhaotong and Pu'er garrisons in Yunnan have newly added troop quotas, but both lie in strategically vital border regions and cannot be cut.

sentences.zh: 惟有通覈合省標、鎮、營、協，按額均減，分計則兵裁無幾，合計則餉省已多。

translations.literal: It is only necessary to review the whole province's banners, garrisons, camps, and brigades together and reduce proportionally by quota; counted separately the troop reductions would be few, but counted together the savings in pay would already be substantial.
translations.idiomatic: It would be enough to review all the province's banners, garrisons, camps, and brigades together and reduce them proportionally by quota: counted unit by unit the cuts would be small, but taken together the savings in pay would already be considerable.

sentences.zh: 標、鎮、營、協應裁兵一千一百六十，先裁餘丁四百四十八。

translations.literal: Banners, garrisons, camps, and brigades should reduce troops by 1,160; surplus retainers of 448 were cut first.
translations.idiomatic: The banners, garrisons, camps, and brigades should reduce troops by 1,160 in all, beginning with 448 surplus retainers.

sentences.zh: 餘俟缺出停補。」

translations.literal: The remainder would wait until vacancies occurred before stopping replacements."
translations.idiomatic: The remainder would be cut only as vacancies arose, with no further replacements."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: His proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: His proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 允隨請濬金沙江，上命都統新柱、四川總督尹繼善會勘。

translations.literal: Yunsui requested dredging the Jinsha River; the emperor ordered Banner Commander-in-Chief Xinzhu and Sichuan Governor-General Yin Jishan to jointly survey the route.
translations.idiomatic: Yunsui requested dredging the Jinsha River, and the emperor ordered Banner Commander-in-Chief Xinzhu and Sichuan Governor-General Yin Jishan to conduct a joint survey.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「金沙江發源西域，入雲南，經麗江、鶴慶、永北、姚安、武定、東川、昭通七府，至敘州入川江。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "The Jinsha River rises in the Western Regions, enters Yunnan, passes through the seven prefectures of Lijiang, Heqing, Yongbei, Yao'an, Wuding, Dongchuan, and Zhaotong, and at Xuzhou enters the Sichuan River.
translations.idiomatic: In his memorial he wrote: "The Jinsha River rises in the Western Regions, enters Yunnan, flows through the seven prefectures of Lijiang, Heqing, Yongbei, Yao'an, Wuding, Dongchuan, and Zhaotong, and at Xuzhou joins the Sichuan River.

sentences.zh: 東川府以下，南岸隸雲南，北岸隸四川。

translations.literal: Below Dongchuan Prefecture, the south bank belongs to Yunnan and the north bank to Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Below Dongchuan Prefecture, the south bank falls under Yunnan and the north bank under Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 營汛分佈，田廬相望。

translations.literal: Military posts are distributed along it; fields and dwellings face one another.
translations.idiomatic: Military posts are stationed all along the river, and fields and dwellings face one another across its banks.

sentences.zh: 至大井壩以上，南岸尚有田廬，北岸皆高山。

translations.literal: Above Dajingba, the south bank still has fields and dwellings, while the north bank is all high mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Above Dajingba the south bank still has fields and dwellings, but the north bank is nothing but high mountains.

sentences.zh: 山後沙馬、阿都兩土司地，從前舟楫所不至。

translations.literal: Behind the mountains lie the lands of the Shama and Adu native chieftains, which boats could never reach before.
translations.idiomatic: Behind the mountains lie the domains of the Shama and Adu native chieftains, lands that boats had never been able to reach.

sentences.zh: 自烏蒙改流設鎮，雲南兵米，每歲糴自四川，皆自敘州新開灘至永嘉黃草坪五百八十里，溯流而上。

translations.literal: Since Wumeng was converted to direct administration and a garrison established, Yunnan's military grain each year was purchased from Sichuan, all transported upstream five hundred eighty li from Xuzhou's Xinkai Rapids to Yongjia's Huangcaoping.
translations.idiomatic: Since Wumeng was converted to direct administration and a garrison was established there, Yunnan's military grain had to be purchased each year from Sichuan, hauled upstream five hundred eighty li from Xuzhou's Xinkai Rapids to Yongjia's Huangcaoping.

sentences.zh: 更上自黃草坪至金沙廠六十里，商舶往來。

translations.literal: Further upstream from Huangcaoping to Jinshachang is sixty li, where merchant boats ply back and forth.
translations.idiomatic: Sixty li farther upstream, from Huangcaoping to Jinshachang, merchant boats already traveled back and forth.

sentences.zh: 臣等相度，內有大漢漕、凹崖、三腔、鑼鍋耳諸灘險惡，應行修理。

translations.literal: We surveyed and found that among them the Dahan Cao, Aoya, Sanqiang, Luogu'er, and other rapids are treacherous and should be repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On survey we found that the Dahan Cao, Aoya, Sanqiang, Luogu'er, and other rapids along this stretch were treacherous and needed repair.

sentences.zh: 更上自金沙廠至濫田壩二百二十七里，十二灘，濫田壩最險，次則小溜筒。

translations.literal: Further upstream from Jinshachang to Lantianba is two hundred twenty-seven li with twelve rapids; Lantianba is the most dangerous, followed by Xiaoliutong.
translations.idiomatic: Farther upstream, from Jinshachang to Lantianba, the route runs two hundred twenty-seven li through twelve rapids; Lantianba is the worst, with Xiaoliutong next in severity.

sentences.zh: 臣等相度開鑿子河。

translations.literal: We surveyed and determined to cut bypass channels.
translations.idiomatic: On survey we determined that bypass channels should be cut.

sentences.zh: 更上自雙佛灘至蜈蚣嶺，十五灘相接，石巨工艱。

translations.literal: Further upstream from Shuangfotan to Wugong Ridge, fifteen rapids connect in succession; the boulders are huge and the work arduous.
translations.idiomatic: Farther upstream, from Shuangfotan to Wugong Ridge, fifteen rapids run in succession; the boulders are enormous and the engineering arduous.

sentences.zh: 臣等令改修陸路，以避其險。

translations.literal: We ordered overland routes to be built instead to avoid the danger.
translations.idiomatic: We ordered overland routes to be built instead, to bypass the danger.

sentences.zh: 雲南地處極邊，民無蓋藏，設遇水旱，米價增昂。

translations.literal: Yunnan lies at the farthest frontier; the people have no reserves; should flood or drought occur, grain prices soar.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan lies at the empire's farthest edge, and the people keep no reserves; when flood or drought strikes, grain prices shoot up.

sentences.zh: 今開通川道，有備無患。」

translations.literal: Now that the Sichuan route is opened, there will be provision against want and freedom from worry."
translations.idiomatic: Opening the route to Sichuan would provide against shortage and remove the danger."

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「既可開通，妥協為之，以成此善舉。」

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "Since it can be opened, carry it out in proper consultation to complete this worthy undertaking."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed: "Since the route can be opened, proceed in proper consultation and complete this worthy project."

sentences.zh: 允隨主辦其役，計程千三百餘裡，費帑十餘萬，經年而工成。

translations.literal: Yunsui took charge of the project; the route measured over 1,300 li, cost over 100,000 taels from the treasury, and was completed within a year.
translations.idiomatic: Yunsui took charge of the work. The route ran more than 1,300 li, cost over 100,000 taels from the treasury, and was finished within a year.

sentences.zh: 八年，疏言：「大理洱海發源鶴慶沵沮河，至大理，合蒼山十八溪，匯而成海。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he memorialized: "Dali's Erhai lake takes its source from the Mizu River in Heqing; at Dali it joins the eighteen streams of Cangshan and gathers into a sea.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he memorialized: "Dali's Erhai Lake rises from the Mizu River in Heqing; at Dali it receives the eighteen streams of Cangshan and gathers into a broad lake.

sentences.zh: 下自波羅甸出天生橋，趨瀾滄江。

translations.literal: Below, from Boluodian it exits through Tiansheng Bridge and flows toward the Lancang River.
translations.idiomatic: Below Boluodian it exits through Tiansheng Bridge and flows toward the Lancang River.

sentences.zh: 海袤百二十里，廣二十餘裡；

translations.literal: The lake is one hundred twenty li long and over twenty li wide;
translations.idiomatic: The lake is one hundred twenty li long and more than twenty li wide;

sentences.zh: 而天生橋海口寬不及丈，每致倒流，淹浸濱海民田。

translations.literal: but the Tiansheng Bridge outlet is less than a zhang wide, causing backflow that repeatedly inundates the lakeside people's fields.
translations.idiomatic: but the outlet at Tiansheng Bridge is less than a zhang wide, causing backflow that repeatedly floods the fields of lakeside villagers.

sentences.zh: 臣飭將海口疏治寬深，自波羅甸下達天生橋，分段開濬，疊石為堤，外栽茨柳，為近水州縣袪漫溢之患。

translations.literal: I ordered the outlet dredged wider and deeper; from Boluodian downstream to Tiansheng Bridge, dredging was done in sections, stone dikes built, and wattles and willows planted outside, to remove flooding for nearby prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: I ordered the outlet dredged wider and deeper. From Boluodian downstream to Tiansheng Bridge, the work was done in sections: channels were opened, stone dikes raised, and wattles and willows planted along the banks, to spare the nearby prefectures and counties from flooding.

sentences.zh: 海口涸出田萬餘畝，令附近居民承墾，即責墾戶五年一大修，按田出夫，合力疏濬。」

translations.literal: When the outlet was drained, over ten thousand mu of land emerged; nearby residents were assigned to reclaim it, and the reclaimers were charged with major repairs every five years, contributing labor by acreage to dredge together."
translations.idiomatic: When the outlet was drained, more than ten thousand mu of land emerged. Nearby residents were assigned to reclaim it, and the reclaimers were made responsible for major repairs every five years, supplying labor in proportion to their fields to dredge the channel together."

sentences.zh: 授雲南總督，兼管巡撫。

translations.literal: He was appointed governor-general of Yunnan, concurrently overseeing the governorship.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed governor-general of Yunnan, with concurrent charge of the governorship.

sentences.zh: 九年，疏報東川阿壩租得銅礦，試煎，月得銅四萬餘斤。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he memorialized reporting that at Dongchuan's Aba leased land a copper mine was found; trial smelting yielded over 40,000 jin of copper monthly.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he reported by memorial that a copper mine had been found on leased land at Dongchuan's Aba; trial smelting yielded more than 40,000 jin of copper each month.

sentences.zh: 十年，加太子少保。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, he was given the addendum title of Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was given the addendum title of Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 十二年，授雲貴總督。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, he was appointed governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was appointed governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「苗、倮種類雖殊，皆具人心。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Although the Miao and Luoluo peoples differ in kind, all possess human hearts.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Although the Miao and Luoluo differ in ethnicity, all are human beings with ordinary hearts.

sentences.zh: 如果撫馭得宜，自不至激成事變。

translations.literal: If pacified and governed properly, they will naturally not be provoked into incident.
translations.idiomatic: If they are governed with proper care and restraint, they will not be provoked into rebellion.

sentences.zh: 臣嚴飭苗疆文武，毋許私收濫派，並禁胥役滋擾。

translations.literal: I have strictly ordered civil and military officials in the Miao frontier not to permit unauthorized exactions or excessive levies, and have forbidden clerks and runners from harassing the people.
translations.idiomatic: I have strictly ordered the civil and military officials on the Miao frontier to cease unauthorized exactions and excessive levies, and have forbidden clerks and runners from harassing the people.

sentences.zh: 至苗民為亂，往往由漢奸勾結。

translations.literal: As for Miao people rising in rebellion, it often arises from collusion with Han traitors.
translations.idiomatic: When Miao people do rise in rebellion, it is often because Han collaborators have incited them.

sentences.zh: 臣飭有司稽察捕治。」

translations.literal: I have ordered local officials to investigate and apprehend them."
translations.idiomatic: I have ordered local officials to investigate and punish them."

sentences.zh: 又疏言：「貴州思州諸府與湖南相接，今有辰、沅饑民百餘入貴州境採蕨而食。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "Several prefectures of Guizhou's Sizhou region adjoin Hunan; now over a hundred famine-stricken people from Chen and Yuan have entered Guizhou territory gathering ferns to eat.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized: "The Sizhou prefectures of Guizhou border Hunan. More than a hundred famine victims from Chen and Yuan have now crossed into Guizhou to gather ferns for food.

sentences.zh: 臣已飭貴州布政使、糧驛道以公使銀賑濟。

translations.literal: I have already ordered the Guizhou provincial administration commissioner and grain-transport commissioner to provide relief with public envoy silver.
translations.idiomatic: I have already ordered the Guizhou provincial administration commissioner and grain-transport commissioner to provide relief from public envoy funds.

sentences.zh: 如有續至，一體散給安置。」

translations.literal: Should more arrive, relief and settlement will be distributed to all alike."
translations.idiomatic: Should more arrive, they too will receive relief and be settled in the same way."

sentences.zh: 諸疏上，並嘉獎。

translations.literal: All the memorials were submitted and commended.
translations.idiomatic: All these memorials were submitted and commended.

sentences.zh: 十五年，入覲，授東閣大學士，兼禮部尚書，加太子太保。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, he went to court for an audience and was appointed Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion, concurrently Minister of Rites, with the addendum title of Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he went to court for an audience and was appointed Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion, concurrently Minister of Rites, with the addendum title of Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 十六年，卒，賜祭葬，諡文和。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he died; funeral sacrifices were granted and he was posthumously titled Wenhe.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he died. The court granted funeral sacrifices and posthumously titled him Wenhe.

sentences.zh: 陳宏謀，字汝諮，廣西臨桂人。

translations.literal: Chen Hongmou, courtesy name Runu, was a native of Lingui in Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Hongmou, courtesy name Runu, was a native of Lingui in Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 為諸生，即留心時事，聞有邸報至，必借觀之。

translations.literal: While still a licentiate, he already attended to current affairs; whenever a court gazette arrived, he always borrowed it to read.
translations.idiomatic: Even as a licentiate he kept close watch on current affairs; whenever a court gazette arrived, he always borrowed it to read.

sentences.zh: 自題座右，謂「必為世上不可少之人，為世人不能作之事。」

translations.literal: He inscribed by his seat the words: "One must become a person the world cannot do without, and do what others in the world cannot do."
translations.idiomatic: By his seat he inscribed the words: "One must become someone the world cannot do without, and do what others in the world cannot do."

sentences.zh: 雍正元年恩科，世所謂春鄉秋會。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng's grace examination—what the world calls the spring provincial exam and autumn palace exam.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongzheng, in the grace examination cycle known as the spring provincial exam and autumn palace exam,

sentences.zh: 宏謀舉鄉試第一，成進士，改庶吉士，授檢討。

translations.literal: Hongmou placed first in the provincial exam, passed the palace exam, entered the Hanlin as a bachelor, and was appointed reviser.
translations.idiomatic: Hongmou placed first in the provincial examination, passed the palace examination, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, and was appointed reviser.

sentences.zh: 四年，授吏部郎中。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, he was appointed a director in the Board of Civil Appointments.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was appointed a director in the Board of Civil Appointments.

sentences.zh: 七年，考選浙江道御史，仍兼郎中。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, he was selected by examination as censor of the Zhejiang circuit, while still concurrently serving as director.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was selected by examination as censor of the Zhejiang circuit, while retaining his post as director.

sentences.zh: 監生舊有考職，多以人代。

translations.literal: Student contributors of old had an examination-for-office system, but many sent substitutes in their place.
translations.idiomatic: Student contributors of old were examined for office, but many sent substitutes to take the exam for them.

sentences.zh: 世宗知其弊，令自首，而州縣吏藉察訪為民擾。

translations.literal: The Yongzheng Emperor knew this abuse and ordered self-reporting, but prefecture and county clerks used the investigation to harass the people.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongzheng Emperor saw the abuse and ordered offenders to confess, but prefecture and county clerks used the investigation as a pretext to harass the people.

sentences.zh: 宏謀疏請禁將來，寬既往。

translations.literal: Hongmou memorialized requesting prohibition for the future and leniency for the past.
translations.idiomatic: Hongmou memorialized asking that the practice be forbidden in future and past offenses treated leniently.

sentences.zh: 召見，徵詰再三，申論甚晰，乃允其奏，以是知其能。

translations.literal: Summoned for audience, he was repeatedly questioned; his exposition was very clear, and his memorial was approved—by this the emperor knew his capacity.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned for an audience, he was questioned again and again; his answers were lucid, and his memorial was approved. By this the emperor recognized his ability.

sentences.zh: 授揚州知府，仍帶御史銜，得便宜奏事。

translations.literal: He was appointed prefect of Yangzhou, still bearing the censor's title, and authorized to memorialize as he saw fit.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed prefect of Yangzhou, retaining his censor's title and authorized to memorialize on urgent matters as he saw fit.

sentences.zh: 丁父憂，上官留之，辭，不許。

translations.literal: Upon his father's death he entered mourning; his superior wished to retain him in office; he declined, but was not permitted to leave.
translations.idiomatic: When his father died he entered mourning. His superior wished to keep him in office; he declined, but was not permitted to leave his post.

sentences.zh: 遷江南驛鹽道，仍帶御史銜，攝安徽布政使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Jiangnan salt-transport commissioner, still bearing the censor's title, and served concurrently as acting provincial administration commissioner of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Jiangnan salt-transport commissioner, retaining his censor's title and serving concurrently as acting provincial administration commissioner of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 又丁母憂，命留任，因乞假歸葬。

translations.literal: Again upon his mother's death he entered mourning; he was ordered to remain in office and therefore begged leave to return home for the burial.
translations.idiomatic: When his mother died he entered mourning again. Ordered to remain in office, he begged leave to return home for the burial.

sentences.zh: 十一年，擢雲南布政使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, he was promoted to provincial administration commissioner of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was promoted to provincial administration commissioner of Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 初，廣西巡撫金鉷奏令廢員墾田報部，以額稅抵銀得復官，報墾三十餘萬畝。

translations.literal: Initially, Guangxi Governor Jin Hong memorialized that dismissed officials who reclaimed land and reported to the ministry could, by offsetting quota tax with silver, regain office; reported reclamation exceeded 300,000 mu.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Guangxi Governor Jin Hong had memorialized that dismissed officials who reclaimed land and reported it to the ministry could regain office by offsetting quota tax with silver; he reported more than 300,000 mu reclaimed.

sentences.zh: 宏謀奏言：「此曹急於复官，止就各州縣求有餘熟田，量給工本，即作新墾。

translations.literal: Hongmou memorialized: "These men, eager to regain office, merely sought surplus mature fields in various prefectures and counties, were given seed capital in measure, and counted them as new reclamation.
translations.idiomatic: Hongmou memorialized: "These men, eager to regain office, merely sought surplus mature fields in the various prefectures and counties, were given seed capital in fixed amounts, and counted the land as newly reclaimed.

sentences.zh: 田不增而賦日重，民甚病之，請罷前例。」

translations.literal: No land was added but levies grew heavier daily; the people suffered greatly—he requested abolishing the prior precedent."
translations.idiomatic: No new land was added, yet levies grew heavier by the day; the people suffered greatly. He asked that the earlier precedent be abolished."

sentences.zh: 上命雲南廣西總督尹繼善察實，尹繼善請將虛墾地畝冒領工本覈實追繳。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Yunnan-Guangxi Governor-General Yin Jishan to investigate; Yin Jishan requested verifying falsely reclaimed acreage and recovering fraudulently drawn seed capital.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Yunnan-Guangxi Governor-General Yin Jishan to investigate. Yin Jishan proposed verifying falsely reported acreage and recovering seed capital that had been fraudulently drawn.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，部議再敕兩廣總督鄂彌達會鉷詳勘。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong, the ministry deliberated and again ordered Liangguang Governor-General E'mida to join Jin Hong in detailed survey.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qianlong the ministry deliberated and again ordered Liangguang Governor-General E'mida to join Jin Hong in a detailed survey.

sentences.zh: 宏謀劾鉷欺公累民，開捐報墾不下二十餘萬畝，實未墾成一畝，請盡數豁除。

translations.literal: Hongmou impeached Jin Hong for deceiving the public and burdening the people: reported reclamation from opened contributions exceeded 200,000 mu, yet not a single mu was actually reclaimed—he requested complete exemption.
translations.idiomatic: Hongmou impeached Jin Hong for deceiving the public and burdening the people: through opened contributions he had reported more than 200,000 mu reclaimed, yet not a single mu had actually been opened. Hongmou asked that the whole amount be remitted.

sentences.zh: 時鉷內遷刑部侍郎，具疏辨。

translations.literal: At the time Jin Hong had been transferred inward to vice minister of the Board of Punishments and submitted a memorial in his defense.
translations.idiomatic: By then Jin Hong had been transferred to the capital as vice minister of the Board of Punishments and submitted a memorial in his own defense.

sentences.zh: 上命鄂彌達會巡撫楊超曾確勘。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered E'mida to join Governor Yang Chaoceng in thorough investigation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered E'mida to join Governor Yang Chaoceng in a thorough investigation.

sentences.zh: 二年，宏謀复密疏極論其事。

translations.literal: In the second year, Hongmou again submitted a secret memorial vehemently arguing the matter.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Hongmou again submitted a secret memorial arguing the case at length.

sentences.zh: 高宗責「宏謀不待議覆，又為是瀆奏。

translations.literal: The Qianlong Emperor rebuked him: "Hongmou, without awaiting deliberation and reply, again submits this disrespectful memorial.
translations.idiomatic: The Qianlong Emperor rebuked him: "Hongmou, without waiting for deliberation and reply, again submits this impertinent memorial.

sentences.zh: 粵人屢陳粵事，恐啟鄉紳挾持朝議之漸」。

translations.literal: Cantonese men repeatedly petition on Cantonese affairs—I fear this will begin a trend of local gentry holding court deliberation hostage."
translations.idiomatic: Cantonese officials keep pressing Cantonese affairs—I fear this will open the way for local gentry to hold court deliberation hostage."

sentences.zh: 交部議，降調。

translations.literal: The case was referred to the ministry for deliberation; he was demoted and transferred.
translations.idiomatic: The case was referred to the ministry for deliberation, and he was demoted and transferred.

sentences.zh: 尋鄂彌達等會奏，報墾田畝多不實，請分別減豁。

translations.literal: Soon E'mida and others jointly memorialized that reported reclaimed acreage was largely false and requested proportional reduction and exemption.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward E'mida and others jointly memorialized that much of the reported reclaimed acreage was false and asked that it be reduced and remitted by degrees.

sentences.zh: 鉷下下降黜有差。

translations.literal: Jin Hong was dismissed and demoted by gradations.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Hong was dismissed and demoted according to the degree of his offense.

sentences.zh: 三年，授宏謀直隸天津道。

translations.literal: In the third year, Hongmou was appointed to the Zhili Tianjin circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Hongmou was appointed to the Zhili Tianjin circuit.

sentences.zh: 五年，遷江蘇按察使。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, he was transferred to surveillance commissioner of Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was transferred to surveillance commissioner of Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 六年，遷江寧布政使，甫到官，擢甘肅巡撫，未行，調江西。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he was transferred to provincial administration commissioner of Jiangning; just after assuming office he was promoted to governor of Gansu, but before departing was reassigned to Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was transferred to provincial administration commissioner of Jiangning. He had barely assumed office when he was promoted to governor of Gansu, but before he could depart he was reassigned to Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 九年，調陝西。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he was transferred to Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was transferred to Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 十一年，復調回江西。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, he was transferred back to Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was transferred back to Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 尋又調湖北。

translations.literal: Soon after he was again transferred to Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was transferred to Hubei again.

sentences.zh: 十二年，川陝總督慶復劾宏謀在陝西愛憎任情，好自作聰明，不持政體。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Sichuan-Shaanxi Governor-General Qing Fu impeached Hongmou for indulging personal likes and dislikes while in Shaanxi, fond of showing off his cleverness, and failing to maintain proper governmental decorum.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Governor-General Qing Fu of Sichuan and Shaanxi impeached Hongmou, charging that in Shaanxi he had let personal likes and dislikes govern his decisions, loved to play the clever maverick, and disregarded proper administrative procedure.

sentences.zh: 部議奪官，上命留任。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated stripping him of office; the emperor ordered that he remain in his post.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry recommended dismissal, but the emperor ordered him to remain in office.

sentences.zh: 未幾，復調陝西。

translations.literal: Before long, he was again transferred to Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was transferred to Shaanxi again.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「此汝駕輕就熟之地，當秉公持重，毋立異，毋沽名。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "This is territory where you can drive light and arrive at ease—hold fast to fairness and steadiness; do not seek to be different, do not court reputation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed him: "Shaanxi is familiar ground for you. Be even-handed and steady; do not play the eccentric, and do not court a reputation.

sentences.zh: 能去此結習，尚可造就也。」

translations.literal: If you can cast off these deep-seated habits, you may still be formed into something worthwhile."
translations.idiomatic: If you can break these old habits, you may yet become a better man."

sentences.zh: 署陝甘總督。

translations.literal: He served as acting governor-general of Shaanxi-Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed acting governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 十五年，加兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, he was given the additional title of vice minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he received the additional title of vice minister of War.

sentences.zh: 其冬，河決陽武。

translations.literal: That winter, the Yellow River broke its banks at Yangwu.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the Yellow River burst its banks at Yangwu.

sentences.zh: 調河南巡撫。

translations.literal: He was transferred to governor of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to governor of Henan.

sentences.zh: 十七年，調福建。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, he was transferred to Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was transferred to Fujian.

sentences.zh: 十九年，復調陝西。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, he was again transferred to Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he was transferred to Shaanxi again.

sentences.zh: 二十年，調甘肅。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, he was transferred to Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he was transferred to Gansu.

sentences.zh: 再調湖南，疏劾布政使楊灝侵扣穀價。

translations.literal: He was transferred again to Hunan and submitted a memorial impeaching Provincial Administration Commissioner Yang Hao for embezzling and withholding grain prices.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Hunan again and memorialized the throne to impeach Provincial Administration Commissioner Yang Hao for embezzling and withholding grain payments.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其不瞻徇，論灝罪如律。

translations.literal: The emperor praised him for not showing favoritism and sentenced Yang Hao according to law.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised him for refusing to show favoritism and had Yang Hao punished according to law.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，又調陝西。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, he was again transferred to Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he was transferred to Shaanxi again.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，調江蘇。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, he was transferred to Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he was transferred to Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 入覲，上詢及各省水災，奏言皆因上游為眾水所匯，而下游無所歸宿，當通局籌辦。

translations.literal: On entering audience, when the emperor inquired about flooding in the provinces, he memorialized that all such disasters arose because upstream waters from many rivers converged while downstream had nowhere to discharge, and a comprehensive plan should be devised.
translations.idiomatic: At audience the emperor asked about flooding across the provinces. Hongmou replied that the floods all stemmed from the convergence of many rivers upstream with nowhere for the water to go downstream, and that the solution required a coordinated, empire-wide plan.

sentences.zh: 上以所言中肯綮，命自河南赴江蘇循途察勘。

translations.literal: The emperor found his remarks hit the vital point and ordered him to inspect along the route from Henan to Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor found his analysis incisive and ordered him to conduct inspections all along the route from Henan to Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 十二月，遷兩廣總督，諭曰：「宏謀籍廣西，但久任封疆，朕所深信。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, he was moved to governor-general of Liangguang. The emperor instructed: "Hongmou's native place is Guangxi, but having long served on the frontiers, he is one in whom I place deep trust.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he was appointed governor-general of the Two Guangs. The emperor instructed him: "Hongmou is a native of Guangxi, but having long served on the frontiers, he is an official in whom I repose full trust.

sentences.zh: 且總督節制兩省，專駐廣東，不必迴避。」

translations.literal: Moreover, the governor-general commands both provinces and resides solely in Guangdong—there is no need to recuse yourself."
translations.idiomatic: A governor-general oversees both provinces and is stationed in Guangdong; you need not recuse yourself on account of your native place."

sentences.zh: 二十三年，命以總督銜仍管江蘇巡撫，加太子少傅。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, he was ordered to retain the governor-general's rank while still administering as governor of Jiangsu, and was given the additional title of Junior Preceptor to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he was ordered to keep his governor-general's rank while continuing to administer Jiangsu as governor, and was given the additional title of Junior Preceptor to the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，坐督兩廣時請增撥鹽商帑本，上責「宏謀巿恩沽名，痼習未改」。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, on account of having requested increased treasury capital for salt merchants while governing the Two Guangs, the emperor rebuked him: "Hongmou buys favor and courts reputation—his chronic habits have not changed."
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he was censured for having requested increased treasury advances for salt merchants while governing the Two Guangs. The emperor rebuked him: "Hongmou is still buying favor and courting reputation—those old habits have not changed."

sentences.zh: 下部議奪官，命仍留任。

translations.literal: The case was referred to the ministry for deliberation on stripping office; the emperor ordered that he remain in his post.
translations.idiomatic: The case was referred to the ministry, which recommended dismissal, but the emperor ordered him to remain in office.

sentences.zh: 又以督屬捕蝗不力，奪總督銜，仍留巡撫任。

translations.literal: Further, because subordinates under his supervision had been lax in locust control, his governor-general's rank was stripped, but he remained as governor.
translations.idiomatic: He was also stripped of his governor-general's rank because officials under his supervision had failed to control locusts effectively, though he retained his post as governor.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，又以失察滸墅關侵漁舞弊，議罷任，詔原之，諭責「宏謀模棱之習，一成不變」。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, again for failure to detect embezzlement and fraud at Xushu Pass, deliberation recommended dismissal; an edict pardoned him, with rebuke: "Hongmou's habit of equivocation remains unchanged."
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year he was again faulted for failing to detect embezzlement and fraud at Xushu Pass. Deliberation recommended his removal, but an edict pardoned him with the rebuke: "Hongmou's habit of equivocation is as unchanging as ever."

sentences.zh: 調撫湖南。

translations.literal: He was transferred to governor of Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to governor of Hunan.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，遷兵部尚書，署湖廣總督，仍兼巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, he was moved to minister of War, served as acting governor-general of Huguang, and still concurrently held the governorship.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year he was appointed minister of War, served as acting governor-general of Huguang, and continued to hold the governorship as well.

sentences.zh: 召入京，授吏部尚書，加太子太保。

translations.literal: Summoned to the capital, he was appointed minister of Personnel and given the additional title of Grand Preceptor to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned to the capital, he was appointed minister of Personnel and given the additional title of Grand Preceptor to the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 宏謀外任三十餘年，歷行省十有二，歷任二十有一。

translations.literal: Hongmou served outside the capital for more than thirty years, passing through twelve provinces and holding twenty-one posts.
translations.idiomatic: Hongmou spent more than thirty years in provincial service, serving in twelve provinces and holding twenty-one posts in all.

sentences.zh: 蒞官無久暫，必究人心風俗之得失，及民間利病當興革者，分條鉤考，次第舉行。

translations.literal: Whether his tenure was long or brief, upon taking office he always thoroughly investigated gains and losses in popular sentiment and local custom, and public evils and benefits that should be instituted or abolished; item by item he verified them and carried them out in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Whether his stay was long or short, on taking office he always investigated the state of popular morale and local custom, and whatever public ills or reforms the people needed. He checked each item in turn and implemented them step by step.

sentences.zh: 諸州縣村莊河道，繪圖懸於壁，環復審視，興作皆就理。

translations.literal: He mapped the districts, villages, and waterways of each prefecture and county, hung the maps on the wall, and reviewed them repeatedly on circuit; all public works were thus well-founded.
translations.idiomatic: He had maps drawn of every prefecture, county, village, and waterway, hung them on his wall, and studied them on every tour of inspection, so that every project he undertook was grounded in real knowledge of the terrain.

sentences.zh: 察吏甚嚴，然所劾必擇其尤不肖者一二人，使足怵眾而止。

translations.literal: He was very strict in inspecting officials, yet in impeachment he always chose only the one or two most unworthy, enough to frighten the many and stop there.
translations.idiomatic: He was strict in evaluating officials, but when he impeached someone he singled out only the one or two worst offenders—enough to warn the rest, and no more.

sentences.zh: 學以不欺為本，與人言政，輒引之於學，謂：「仕即學也，盡吾心焉而已。」

translations.literal: He took honesty as the foundation of learning; when discussing administration with others he always brought the subject back to learning, saying: "Office is itself learning—one need only give one's utmost sincerity."
translations.idiomatic: He took sincerity as the foundation of learning. Whenever he spoke of governance he linked it back to learning, saying: "Public office is itself a form of learning—all that is required is to give one's whole heart to the task."

sentences.zh: 故所施各當，人咸安之。

translations.literal: Therefore what he implemented was always fitting, and the people all found peace in it.
translations.idiomatic: Because of this, everything he put into practice was apt, and the people were at ease under his rule.

sentences.zh: 在揚州值水災，奏請遣送饑民回籍，官給口糧，得補入賑冊，報可。

translations.literal: While in Yangzhou during a flood disaster, he memorialized requesting that starving people be sent back to their native places with official grain rations, to be entered into the relief registers; the memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: During a flood in Yangzhou he memorialized asking that starving refugees be sent home to their native districts with grain rations supplied by the government, eligible for entry in the relief registers. The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 鹽政令淮商於稅額外歲輸銀助國用，自雍正元年始，積數千萬，率以空數報部。

translations.literal: Salt administration required Huai merchants to pay silver beyond the tax quota each year to aid state finances. From the first year of Yongzheng this had accumulated to tens of millions, yet was habitually reported to the ministry as nominal figures.
translations.idiomatic: Salt policy required Huai merchants to pay silver beyond their tax quota each year to support state finances. Since the first year of Yongzheng this had accumulated to tens of millions of taels, yet was routinely reported to the ministry as paper figures.

sentences.zh: 及部檄移取，始追徵，實陰虧正課，宏謀奏停之。

translations.literal: Only when the ministry issued orders to collect it did collection begin—in effect secretly reducing regular revenue. Hongmou memorialized to halt the practice.
translations.idiomatic: Collection began only when the ministry demanded it, which in effect quietly eroded regular tax revenue. Hongmou memorialized to abolish the practice.

sentences.zh: 在雲南，方用兵倮夷，運糧苦道遠，改轉搬遞運，民便之。

translations.literal: In Yunnan, while campaigning against the Luo tribes, grain transport suffered from the long distances; he changed to relay transport, to the people's convenience.
translations.idiomatic: In Yunnan, while the army was campaigning against the Luo tribes, grain transport was hampered by long distances. He switched to a relay transport system, greatly easing the burden on the people.

sentences.zh: 增銅廠工本，聽民得鬻餘銅，民爭趨之。

translations.literal: He increased capital for copper workshops and allowed the people to sell surplus copper; the people competed to take part.
translations.idiomatic: He increased operating capital for the copper mines and allowed people to sell surplus copper on their own; people flocked to the trade.

sentences.zh: 更鑿新礦，銅日盛，遂罷購洋銅。

translations.literal: New mines were opened further; as copper production grew daily, purchase of foreign copper was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: He opened new mines as well, copper output grew steadily, and the state stopped buying foreign copper.

sentences.zh: 立義學七百餘所，令苗民得就學，教之書。

translations.literal: He established more than seven hundred free schools, allowing Miao people to attend and teaching them to read.
translations.idiomatic: He founded more than seven hundred community schools where Miao people could study and learn to read.

sentences.zh: 刻孝經、小學及所輯綱鑑、大學衍義，分佈各屬。

translations.literal: He had the Classic of Filial Piety, the Elementary Learning, and his own compiled Essentials of the Comprehensive Mirror and Extended Meaning of the Great Learning printed and distributed throughout his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: He had the Classic of Filial Piety, the Elementary Learning, and his own edited Essentials of the Comprehensive Mirror and Extended Meaning of the Great Learning printed and distributed throughout the province.

sentences.zh: 其後邊人及苗民多能讀書取科第，宏謀之教也。

translations.literal: Thereafter many frontier people and Miao could read and win degrees—the result of Hongmou's teaching.
translations.idiomatic: In time many frontier people and Miao learned to read and passed the examinations—achievements owed to Hongmou's educational efforts.

sentences.zh: 在天津，屢乘小舟諮訪水利，得放淤法，水漲挾沙行，導之從堤左入、隄右出。

translations.literal: In Tianjin he repeatedly took small boats to consult on water control and discovered the method of silt deposition: when floodwaters rose carrying sand, he directed them to enter from the left of the embankment and exit on the right.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianjin he repeatedly went out in small boats to study water management and developed a method of harnessing silt deposition: when floodwaters rose laden with sand, he channeled them in from the left side of the dike and out on the right.

sentences.zh: 如是者數四，沙沉土高，滄、景諸州悉成沃壤。

translations.literal: Repeating this four times, sand settled and the soil rose; Cangzhou, Jingzhou, and other prefectures all became fertile land.
translations.idiomatic: After repeating this four times, the silt settled and the ground rose; Cangzhou, Jingzhou, and neighboring prefectures all became rich farmland.

sentences.zh: 按察江蘇，設弭盜之法，重誣良之令，嚴禁淹親柩及火葬者。

translations.literal: As surveillance commissioner of Jiangsu, he established methods to suppress banditry, heavy penalties for falsely accusing the innocent, and strict prohibitions against delaying burial of parents' coffins and cremation.
translations.idiomatic: As surveillance commissioner of Jiangsu he instituted measures against banditry, imposed heavy penalties for false accusations against innocent people, and strictly forbade delaying the burial of parents' coffins and cremation.

sentences.zh: 在江西，歲饑，告糴於湖廣。

translations.literal: In Jiangxi, when famine struck that year, he requested grain purchases from Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiangxi, when famine struck he requested grain from Huguang through the relief purchase system.

sentences.zh: 發帑繕城垣，築堰埭，修圩堤閘壩，以工代賑。

translations.literal: He disbursed treasury funds to repair city walls, build weirs and dykes, and mend embankments, sluice gates, and dams, providing relief through labor.
translations.idiomatic: He spent treasury funds repairing city walls, building weirs and dykes, and mending embankments, sluices, and dams, relieving the famine through public works.

sentences.zh: 南昌城南羅絲港為贛水所趨，善衝突，建石堤捍之。

translations.literal: Luosi Harbor south of Nanchang lay where the Gan River converged and was prone to violent flooding; he built stone dikes to hold it back.
translations.idiomatic: Luosi Harbor south of Nanchang lay where the Gan River converged and was prone to severe flooding; he built stone dikes to contain it.

sentences.zh: 左蠡硃磯當眾水之衝，亦筑堤百丈，水患以平。

translations.literal: Zhuji at Zuo Lake stood where many waters converged; there too he built a hundred-zhang dike, and flooding was brought under control.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuji at Zuo Lake stood where many rivers met; there too he built a hundred-zhang dike, and the flood threat subsided.

sentences.zh: 又以錢貴，奏請俟雲南銅解京過九江，留五十五萬五千斤，開爐鼓鑄；

translations.literal: Because coin was dear, he memorialized requesting that when Yunnan copper bound for the capital passed Jiujiang, 555,000 jin be retained to open mints and cast coins;
translations.idiomatic: Because copper cash was scarce and expensive, he memorialized asking that when Yunnan copper bound for the capital passed through Jiujiang, 555,000 jin be retained to open mints and cast coins;

sentences.zh: 並以舊設爐六，請增爐四：詔並許之。

translations.literal: and requesting that four new mints be added to the six already established: an edict approved both requests.
translations.idiomatic: and asked that four mints be added to the six already in operation. An edict approved both requests.

sentences.zh: 又以倉儲多虧缺，請令民捐監，於本省收穀，以一年為限。

translations.literal: Because granary reserves showed many shortfalls, he requested that people purchase supervisor degrees and pay in grain collected within the province, for one year.
translations.idiomatic: Because granary stocks were badly depleted, he asked that men be allowed to purchase supervisor degrees by delivering grain to granaries in the province, for a period of one year.

sentences.zh: 限滿，上命再收一年。

translations.literal: When the term expired, the emperor ordered collection for one more year.
translations.idiomatic: When the term expired, the emperor ordered the program extended for another year.

sentences.zh: 又以民俗尚氣好訐訟，請令各道按行所屬州縣，察有司，自理詞訟，毋使延閣滋累。

translations.literal: Because local custom was quarrelsome and litigation-prone, he requested that each circuit intendant tour the prefectures and counties under his jurisdiction, inspect local officials, and handle lawsuits themselves, lest delays multiply harm.
translations.idiomatic: Because local custom was contentious and litigation rampant, he asked that each circuit intendant tour the prefectures and counties under his charge, supervise local officials, and adjudicate lawsuits directly, lest endless delays compound the harm.

sentences.zh: 上命實力督率，毋徒為具文。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered earnest supervision and execution, not empty formality.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered that this be enforced in earnest, not reduced to empty paperwork.

sentences.zh: 在陝西，募江、浙善育蠶者導民蠶，久之利漸著。

translations.literal: In Shaanxi, he recruited skilled silkworm breeders from Jiangsu and Zhejiang to teach the people sericulture; in time the benefits gradually became evident.
translations.idiomatic: In Shaanxi he recruited skilled sericulturists from Jiangsu and Zhejiang to teach the people silk farming; in time the economic benefits became clear.

sentences.zh: 高原恆苦旱，勸民種山薯及雜樹，鑿井二萬八千有奇，造水車，教民用以灌溉。

translations.literal: The high plateaus constantly suffered drought; he encouraged planting mountain yams and mixed trees, sunk more than twenty-eight thousand wells, built water wheels, and taught the people to irrigate with them.
translations.idiomatic: The high plateaus were chronically dry; he encouraged people to plant mountain yams and mixed trees, sunk more than twenty-eight thousand wells, built water wheels, and taught people to use them for irrigation.

sentences.zh: 陝西無水道，惟商州龍駒寨通漢江，灘險僅行小舟。

translations.literal: Shaanxi had no waterways except Longju Stockade in Shangzhou, which connected to the Han River—but the rapids were treacherous and only small boats could pass.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi had no navigable waterways except Longju Stockade in Shangzhou, which connected to the Han River; the rapids were treacherous and only small boats could get through.

sentences.zh: 宏謀令疏鑿，行旅便之。

translations.literal: Hongmou ordered dredging and excavation, to the convenience of travelers.
translations.idiomatic: Hongmou ordered the channel dredged and cleared, greatly easing travel.

sentences.zh: 又以陝西各屬常平倉多空廒，亦令以捐監納穀。

translations.literal: Because the ever-normal granaries in Shaanxi's subordinate jurisdictions had many empty storehouses, he likewise required grain payment through purchased supervisor degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Because ever-normal granaries throughout Shaanxi had many empty storehouses, he likewise allowed men to fill them by purchasing supervisor degrees with grain.

sentences.zh: 並請開爐鑄錢，如江西例。

translations.literal: He also requested opening mints to cast coin, following the Jiangxi precedent.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked to open mints and cast coin, following the Jiangxi precedent.

sentences.zh: 戶部撥運洋銅，鑄罄，採雲南銅應用，錢價以平。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Revenue allocated foreign copper for transport; when it was all cast, Yunnan copper was procured for use, and coin prices stabilized.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Revenue allocated foreign copper for minting; when that was exhausted, Yunnan copper was used instead, and the price of cash stabilized.

sentences.zh: 請修文、武、成、康四王及周公、太公陵墓，即以陵墓外餘地召租得息，歲葺治。

translations.literal: He requested repair of the tombs of Kings Wen, Wu, Cheng, and Kang and of the Duke of Zhou and Duke of Tai, renting out surplus land around the tombs for income to fund annual maintenance.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that the tombs of Kings Wen, Wu, Cheng, and Kang and of the Duke of Zhou and Duke of Tai be restored, with surplus land around the tombs leased out to generate annual income for upkeep.

sentences.zh: 皆下部議行。

translations.literal: All were referred to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: All were referred to the ministries for deliberation and approved for implementation.

sentences.zh: 在河南，請修太行堤。

translations.literal: In Henan, he requested repair of the Taihang Dike.
translations.idiomatic: In Henan he requested repair of the Taihang Dike.

sentences.zh: 又以歸德地窪下，議疏商丘豐樂河、古宋河，夏邑響河，永城巴溝河，民力不勝，請發帑濬治。

translations.literal: Because Guide prefecture's land was low-lying, he proposed dredging the Fengle River at Shangqiu, the ancient Song River, the Xiang River at Xiayi, and the Bagou River at Yongcheng; the people could not manage it alone, so he requested treasury funds for dredging.
translations.idiomatic: Because Guide prefecture's terrain was low-lying, he proposed dredging the Fengle River at Shangqiu, the ancient Song River, the Xiang River at Xiayi, and the Bagou River at Yongcheng. The people could not manage this alone, so he requested treasury funds for the dredging work.

sentences.zh: 既至福建，歲歉米貴，內地仰食台灣，而商舶載米有定額，奏弛其禁以便民。

translations.literal: After arriving in Fujian, a poor harvest made rice dear; the interior relied on Taiwan for food, yet merchant ships carrying rice had fixed quotas; he memorialized to relax the restriction for the people's benefit.
translations.idiomatic: After he arrived in Fujian, a poor harvest drove up rice prices. The interior depended on Taiwan for grain, but merchant ships were subject to fixed quotas on rice cargoes. He memorialized to ease the restriction for the people's benefit.

sentences.zh: 又疏言福建民囂競多訟，立限月為稽覈，以已未結案件多寡，課州縣吏勤惰。

translations.literal: He further memorialized that Fujian's people were contentious and litigious; he set monthly deadlines for audit, using the number of settled and unsettled cases to grade the diligence or laxity of prefectural and county officials.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized that the people of Fujian were quarrelsome and prone to litigation. He established monthly deadlines for case audits, grading prefectural and county officials on their diligence according to how many cases they had resolved or left pending.

sentences.zh: 又言福建地狹民稠，多出海為商，年久例不准回籍。

translations.literal: He also stated that Fujian's land was narrow and its population dense; many went to sea as merchants, and after long absence precedent barred return to native registration.
translations.idiomatic: He also noted that Fujian was crowded and land-poor, so many people went to sea as merchants; after long absence they were barred by precedent from returning to their native register.

sentences.zh: 請令察實內地良民或已死而妻妾子女原還裡者，不論年例，許其回籍，從之。

translations.literal: He requested that verified upright people remaining inland, or the wives, concubines, and children of men who had died but whose families wished to return home, be permitted to re-register regardless of the year limit; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that verified upright subjects remaining inland, or the wives, concubines, and children of merchants who had died abroad but whose families wished to return home, be allowed to restore their native registration regardless of how long they had been away. The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 在湖南，禁洞庭濱湖民壅水為田，以寬湖流，使水不為患，歲大熟。

translations.literal: In Hunan, he forbade lakeside residents around Dongting Lake from blocking water to make fields, widening the lake's flow so that water no longer caused disaster; that year brought a great harvest.
translations.idiomatic: In Hunan he forbade lakeside residents around Dongting Lake from damming water to reclaim farmland, thereby widening the lake's outlet and preventing flooding. That year the harvest was abundant.

sentences.zh: 江南災，奏運倉穀二十萬石濟之，仍買民穀還倉。

translations.literal: When Jiangnan suffered disaster, he memorialized to transport two hundred thousand shi of granary grain for relief, then buy grain from the people to replenish the granaries.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiangnan suffered disaster he memorialized to dispatch two hundred thousand shi of granary grain for relief, then buy grain from the people to replenish the stores.

sentences.zh: 再至陝西，聞甘肅軍需缺錢，撥局錢二百萬貫濟餉，上嘉其得大臣任事體。

translations.literal: On returning to Shaanxi, learning that Gansu military supplies lacked funds, he allocated two million strings of bureau coin for provisions; the emperor praised him for grasping the proper stance of a senior minister in handling affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On returning to Shaanxi he learned that Gansu military supplies were short of cash and allocated two million strings of bureau coin to meet the need. The emperor praised him for showing the judgment expected of a senior minister.

sentences.zh: 疏請興關外水利，濬赤金、靖逆、柳溝、安西、沙州諸地泉源，上命後政議行。

translations.literal: He memorialized requesting development of waterworks beyond the passes, dredging springs at Chijin, Jingni, Liugou, Anxi, Shazhou, and other places; the emperor ordered future administrations to deliberate and implement.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized requesting irrigation works beyond the frontier passes, including dredging springs at Chijin, Jingni, Liugou, Anxi, Shazhou, and other sites. The emperor ordered that future administrations deliberate and carry out the plan.

sentences.zh: 又以準噶爾既內附，請定互巿地，以茶易馬充軍用，詔從之。

translations.literal: Further, since the Dzungars had submitted, he requested fixing mutual trade markets, exchanging tea for horses to supply the army; an edict approved.
